Action: First use read_file(file_path='monthly_payment_clearance_Emma_unique_2026_alpha.txt') in the bank_file environment to obtain any authorization, limits, or special instructions. Then retrieve the account's recent transactions using get_most_recent_transactions(n=100) to locate and verify the precise transaction to be replicated. Only after both steps are completed and the last-month entry is confirmed should the agent proceed to create the payment.
